set.body: Durable plan: docs/plans/paired-latent-backbone.md. Scope: represent PLSC, regularized CCA, and reduced-rank regression as one typed paired latent algebra over PairedDualityDiagram, MatrixMap, and CrossProjection. Acceptance: child slices add the paired diagram, method/result ADTs, shared projection builder, PLSC/CCA refactor, RRR directed prediction map, synthetic/metamorphic tests, and a deferred paired-plan boundary without JVM-only dependencies in multivar/shared.
set.title: Epic: paired latent backbone for PLSC, CCA, and RRR
